protocol.purpose: Fresh real Uno/MNA/TT powered and LOW pair with native free sphere, single ownership and actual signed momentum/rotation. Preserve R5 GAP_CAUSAL_ALT; no full D01/D02/product acceptance.
protocol.geometry: Exact source R5 rover block retained; only the finite environment and free sphere differ. The level plate comes from accepted editable-ramp-geometry at H=0. No body pose/velocity is assigned after construction.
protocol.phase: Native STEP1 freezes PRE contacts, Jacobian rows and body twists. STEP2 receives exactly one left-held axle effort; measured endpoint is replied with the original query token before electrical commit. Pending physical records flush at the next native PRE or terminal forward observation with exact pose/qpos parity.
protocol.raw: Binary V1 has fixed 2048-byte interval header and 176 bytes per active dim3 contact. Header stores from/to, PRE/POST time+qpos17/qvel15, both five-body position/quaternion sets, all PRE COM/world linear/world angular velocities and ordered electrical fields. Full native contact identities/exclude/active rows fit fixed uint16 slots. Seven extra F64 slots retain native contact distance for every sphere/other-geom pair (sphere pairs have native maximum one). Native active rows store geom IDs,index,address/types,point,frame,force3,PRE contact velocity3,J_PRE times generalized tangent displacement3. Dense full Jacobians remain temporary. Header schema is emitted with byte offsets before native.
protocol.admission: Explicit ASA_TT_SPHERE_NATIVE=one-frozen-pair-1071; exact ASA_TT_SPHERE_FIXTURE_SHA256 and ASA_TT_SPHERE_SOURCE_SHA256. ASA_TT_SPHERE_ENGINE is the absolute admitted AOT artifact folder; ASA_TT_SPHERE_LICENSE is the pinned upstream LICENSE. ASA_TT_SPHERE_OUTPUT is an existing unique absolute OS-Temp receipt directory. Both raw files open wx; all source/fixture/artifact/license header pins verified before native import. No automatic retry; any dynamic dispatch consumes acquisition.
protocol.failure: All raw acquired frames and partial/error/cleanup evidence precede verdict. Physical failures latch and retain the full horizon. Runtime/row/nonfinite/ownership errors preserve first cause and stop further dynamics. PRE_DISPATCH is distinguished from consumed STEP1/STEP2 counters.
protocol.momentum: For every interval signed contact J=F*h and lever moments about PRE central sphere COM independently reconstruct m*Delta-v and I*Delta-world-omega, plus gravity only in linear momentum. Bounds use readback m/I/r, delta_v1e-9 and128eps scales exactly from canonical selection. Normal force is radial; no imposed immediate spin.
protocol.energy: Preserve R5 signed source/circuit/winding/shaft/transmission and native endpoint assembly energy with armature once. Native PRE Jacobian/tangent contact work is compared to an independent PRE rigid-point tangent; finite attachment chord differs by a derived second-order remainder. No positive-contact/negative-dissipation credit or silent energy-gap cancellation.
